title: Check any corner for square with just a tape measure (3-4-5 rule)

slides.title: No square? Use your tape measure.

slides.label: The trick
slides.heading: 3 and 4 make a perfect 5
slides.body: From the corner, mark 3" along one side and 4" along the other. If the two marks are exactly 5" apart, the corner is 90°.

slides.heading: Scale it up
items: Deck or shed floor: 3 ft, 4 ft, 5 ft.
slides.tip: Bigger numbers give a more accurate check.

slides.label: Bonus check
slides.heading: Measure both diagonals
slides.body: On any rectangle, measure corner to corner both ways. Same number = square. Not the same? Gently push the two corners of the longer diagonal toward each other until they match.
